Often, Jest testing suite fails due to tests exceeding their allowed runtime. This is due to RPCs being extremely slow at times. For testing, it would make more sense to mock these because there are not needed and would allow for much faster and reliable testing.
Options to consider:
- mocking the RPC package via Jest
- mocking endpoints via MSWJS
- using a local server like Anvil

comments.content: doesn't this mean this is also an issue in production?

I suppose if it gets truncated then it means that there's a higher chance that a collision happens although it's probably still very unlikely.
Just looked up the permit2 contract and it shows that nonce is [uint256](https://github.com/Uniswap/permit2/blob/cc56ad0f3439c502c246fc5cfcc3db92bb8b7219/src/interfaces/ISignatureTransfer.sol#L33)
It seems you got those types from [AllowanceTransfer](https://github.com/Uniswap/permit2/blob/cc56ad0f3439c502c246fc5cfcc3db92bb8b7219/src/interfaces/IAllowanceTransfer.sol) but we are using SignatureTransfer

The code for creating a nonce in `permit-generation` is correct. You just need to change to correct [types](https://github.com/Uniswap/sdks/blob/416793e034dd065fe3310f7c26b75c7255f610bb/sdks/permit2-sdk/src/signatureTransfer.ts#L19) and it should work. Alternatively you can use SDK `@uniswap/permit2-sdk`
